rehearsal_result: Steps A-I executed on DUMMY identifiers (DUMMY_ITEM_01..20). Steps J and K executed as REFUSED gates. No real held-out item number, prediction or label was used.
purpose: Make 'prediction frozen before reveal' mechanically auditable rather than asserted in prose.

steps.name: verify frozen-anchor fingerprint
steps.fails_if: any package file is missing or its SHA-256 differs from the anchor

steps.name: load frozen predictor
steps.note: operative threshold 0.50 only; 0.55 in-fold mode never read

steps.name: identify held-out item IDs using membership ONLY
write prediction artifact
steps.note: artifact must contain no label field

steps.name: score once using preregistered scoring code

hard_requirements: Steps A-I must all pass before step J is even requested.
Step G must be externally backed up before step J is requested.
Step I must be performed by a party other than the prediction writer.
Steps J and K each require their own explicit PI authorization.
A failed or altered prediction artifact invalidates the reveal and requires a new PI decision; it does not license a retry.
explicitly_not_performed_in_this_task: C with real held-out item IDs
